purpose: Mark a final endpoint or the fullest available extent.
keywords: Time noun + を限りに; 声 / 力 + を限りに
We will close the shop at the end of this month.
As of today, I am giving up sweet drinks.
I shouted for help at the top of my voice.
formation: Time noun + を限りに; 声 / 力 + を限りに
restrictions: Time use marks discontinuation; extent use is limited to suitable nouns.
mistake: Do not assume every noun marks a deadline.
